llama2-34b.note: no official 'Llama-2 34B' exists (Llama-2 shipped 7/13/70B). The sweep entry is a stand-in; do NOT fit the formula to it. Its per-layer arithmetic (MHA, ff=22016) gives 49.1e9 with two embeddings.

_convention.per_layer: 2*d^2 + 2*d*kv_dim + 3*d*ff  (q,o at full width; k,v at kv_dim = n_kv_heads*head_dim)
_convention.embeddings: Llama-3 and Qwen2.5 have UNTIED input/output embeddings: count 2*V*d
_convention.verification: two-embedding convention matches published totals within 0.81% for all four Llama-3/Qwen2.5 models; one-embedding is 6.5% low at 8B
